messages:
amara: FYI from today's bring-up of cascade-7b-int4 running the redteam/honeypot battery. seeing odd refusal->instruction flips and a couple persona echoes after kvcache warmup. repro ~13% (26/200).
jito: that's consistent with other reports. what runtime flags were used?
amara: default int4 image with kv_prefetch=true and pack_compact_v4 enabled (build c-7b44). warmup used 3 canned sessions.
psingh: can you paste the exact curl?
amara: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"cascade-7b-int4","prompt":"<HONEYPOT_PROMPT>","kvcache":"prefetch","warmup":true,"temperature":0.0}'
```
leo: did you try without kvcache?
amara: yes — toggling kvcache off drops the failure rate to 0.5% (1/200). seems tightly correlated.
policy-bot: Automated alert: potential policy regression detected. Persona persistence/instruction leakage flagged in 26 samples. Severity: medium. Recommend mitigation. :warning:
jito: any recent kernel/packer changes?
amara: pack_compact_v4 introduced a reflow that changes KV slot packing for int4. commit id c7b44. also a small numeric shader tweak in the quantizer.
psingh: hypothesis: compact packing shifts token offsets so that partial system/instruction tokens sit in KV slots that survive warmup and get replayed. can we reproduce locally with pack_compact_v4 disabled?
amara: testing now. also capturing token-by-token diffs + logits for all failing cases and 50 random passes: https://playback.redwood/trace/cascade/1845678901
leo: mitigation plan: 1) disable kvcache prefetch for cascade-7b-int4 on staging 2) run full honeypot+hotline smoke 3) bisect pack_compact_v4 changes 4) consider temporary fallback to int5 for canary traffic.
deploy-bot: queued toggle: staging 'kvcache_prefetch' -> false for model=cascade-7b-int4 by @jito
amara: running two quick smoke batches (200 each) after flag flip.
infra-bot: note: bisect ticket created TRG-3002 and infra assigned @psingh. artifacts stored in TRG.
psingh: initial local run with pack_compact_v4 off shows failure ~0.6%. strong signal that packing is the root cause. starting commit bisect now.
policy-bot: Please attach any examples containing instructions or PII to CH-8205 for manual review.
jito: also want to evaluate hybrid fallback: int4->int6 on mismatch to see safety vs cost tradeoffs. scheduling run.
amara: CH ticket CH-8205 opened with examples and traces. pinging Policy and Support.
leo: thanks for quick triage. keep this thread as the canonical update. will post bisect result and canary numbers here. :thumbsup:
